parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

*   Valid values: 1 to 100.
*   Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of the NextToken parameter.

parameters.name: PrivatePoolOptions.Id
parameters.description: The ID of the capacity reservation.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the capacity reservation. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-capacity-reservation-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 10 --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --private-pool-options-id crp-bp67acfmxazb40000 --region cn-hangzhou
